默认关闭。仅在字内背景透出开启后可用：日期和附加文字跟随时间使用背景透出与同一遮: Off by default. Available only when “Show background inside text” is on. When off, each keeps its own color and appearance.
默认关闭，开启后点击这侧文字组件打开选定应用。: Off by default. When on, tapping this side's text component opens the selected app.
默认开启，跟随主时间的颜色；主时间启用字内背景透出时，跟随其遮罩颜色，遮罩强度可: On by default. Follows the main time's color. When the main time uses “Show background inside text”, it follows that mask color, and the mask strength can be adjusted separately while the component stays flat. When off, you can set the component color separately.
默认时钟与双排时钟二选一，开关在各自标签的顶部。等宽数字、数字间距、冒号对齐和左: Default clock and two-row clock are mutually exclusive, with switches at the top of each tab. Monospaced digits, digit spacing, colon alignment and left-right spacing are adjusted in "General settings" and shared by both modes.
默认时钟与双排时钟二选一：开启一个会自动关闭另一个，各自的开关在对应标签顶部。竖: Default clock and two-row clock are mutually exclusive: turning one on turns the other off. Each switch is at the top of its tab. When the big clock is enabled on the portrait or landscape notification page, the small time on the pull-down page is taken over by the big clock. The status bar itself still uses this page's settings. The two-row clock only takes over the status bar time; clocks elsewhere, such as the pull-down page, still follow the default clock settings.
默认时钟和双排时钟互斥；通用设置中的等宽、冒号和左右间距同时供两种模式使用。: The default clock and the two-row clock are mutually exclusive. Tabular digits, colon and left/right spacing in general settings apply to both modes.
默认白色，支持颜色自身透明度，并与描边不透明度共同决定浓淡。: Default white. Supports the color's own opacity, which together with outline opacity determines the density.
默认选择全部已支持范围；不改变各功能开关: All supported scopes are selected by default. Feature switches are not changed.
默认顺时针；开启后逆时针。: Clockwise by default. Counterclockwise when on.
